An '''Advanced Recon Commando''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who, along with several others, was given experimental [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]. The [[Commando/Legends|commando's]] armor had red markings.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ARC trooper first appeared in "[[Clone Cadets]],"<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref> the first episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], which premiered on [[September 17]], [[2010]] on [[Cartoon Network]].<ref name="Clone Cadets Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode301.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Clone Cadets}}</ref>
